title: ScoreLedger
description: Point-level and structure-level scoring evidence ledger for a single answer.

task_component_ids.description: Which task components this point serves

material_evidence.description: Exact text from material for normal points. Must be null for an independent extra_material claim.

user_quote.description: Exact quote from user answer. Must exist verbatim in user answer. Null if not covered.

match_type.description: How the user answer matches the material point

point_value.description: 该点满分值。来自 point_definitions.point_value。null时fallback到维度等级制。

earned_value.description: 实得分数。由引擎根据 coverage_status、match_type、expansion_level 和赋分模式自动计算。null时fallback到维度等级制。

expansion_level.description: 用户对该点的展开程度。充分展开=100%；基本展开=85%；简略提及=65%；仅列标题=35%；未提及=0%。留空时引擎按 match_type 保守推导。

expansion_evidence.description: 展开度判定的用户原句证据。

loss_reason.description: Why credit was lost. Must be null for non-independent or optional atomic points.

deduction_owner.description: Primary dimension owning this deduction. Must be null for non-independent or optional atomic points; otherwise validated dynamically against scoring-weights.json. Includes: 任务符合, 要点覆盖, 准确有据, 分类组织, 简洁表达, 关系逻辑, 结论解释, 组织表达, 问题诊断, 针对匹配, 可行具体, 身份文种格式, 内容覆盖, 目的场景, 结构, 语言语气, 立意扣题, 材料运用, 论证深度, 论据例证, 语言.

reference_support.description: Whether reference answers support this point

critical_qualifiers.description: 关键限定/落地动作，仅用于判断总括点是否完整覆盖。

basis.description: Why this element is required or optional

element_value.description: 应用文板块级分值。如格式3分、背景3分、内容12分。结构赋分模式下有值。

earned_value.description: 该板块实得分数。引擎根据 status 和 element_value 自动计算。

deduction_owner.description: Primary dimension owning this deduction. Validated dynamically against scoring-weights.json.

forbidden_results.description: Outcomes that must not occur (validation rules)
